disci.definition:
n an athletic competition in which a disk-shaped object is thrown as far as possible
n a disk used in throwing competitions

disci lentiformis.translation: [医] 丘脑底核, 丘脑下体

disci opticus.translation: [医] 视神经盘, 视神经乳头

disciform.definition: s. having a round or oval shape like a disc
disciform.translation:
a. 椭圆形的
[医] 盘状的

discina.translation: [网络] 圆盘贝；盘形腕足虫

disciple.definition: n. someone who believes and helps to spread the doctrine of another

discipled.translation: n. 门徒, 信徒；弟子

disciples.definition: n. someone who believes and helps to spread the doctrine of another
disciples.translation: n. 信徒( disciple的复数形式 ); 门徒; 耶稣的信徒; （尤指）耶稣十二门徒之一

discipleship.translation: n. 做弟子的身份（期间）

disciplinable.definition:
a. Capable of being disciplined or improved by
   instruction and training.
a. Liable or deserving to be disciplined; subject to
   disciplinary punishment; as, a disciplinable offense.
disciplinable.translation: a. 可以训练的, 应受惩戒的

disciplinableness.definition: n. The quality of being improvable by discipline.

disciplinal.translation: a. 训练的, 风纪的, 惩罚的

disciplinant.translation: n. 苦行者, 严于律已者,自笞教教徒

disciplinarian.definition: n someone who demands exact conformity to rules and forms
disciplinarian.translation:
a. 惩戒性的, 纪律的
n. 执行纪律者, 厉行纪律的人

disciplinarians.definition: n. someone who demands exact conformity to rules and forms
disciplinarians.translation: n. 实施纪律者, 严格纪律信奉者( disciplinarian的复数形式 )

disciplinarity.translation: 学科性, 对同一学科教材的研究

disciplinary.definition:
a. relating to discipline in behavior
a. relating to a specific field of academic study
disciplinary.translation:
a. 训练的, 纪律的, 训诫的
[法] 纪律的, 惩戒性的

disciplinary action.translation: [法] 纪律处分, 惩戒处分

disciplinary procedure.translation: [法] 纪律性程序, 惩戒性程序

disciplinary punishment.translation: [法] 纪律处分, 纪律处罚

discipline.definition:
n. a branch of knowledge
n. a system of rules of conduct or method of practice; 
n. the trait of being well behaved
n. training to improve strength or self-control
discipline.translation:
n. 训练, 纪律
vt. 训练, 惩罚

disciplined.definition:
s. obeying the rules
s. trained mentally or physically by instruction or exercise
disciplined.translation: a. 遵守纪律的；受过训练的

discipliner.translation: n. 学科；纪律；训练；惩罚 (discipline的变形)

disciplines.definition:
n a branch of knowledge
n a system of rules of conduct or method of practice; 
n the trait of being well behaved
n training to improve strength or self-control
n the act of punishing
v develop (children's) behavior by instruction and practice; especially to teach self-control
v punish in order to gain control or enforce obedience

discipling.definition: p. pr. & vb. n. of Disciple
discipling.translation: n. 门徒, 信徒；弟子

disciplining.definition:
v develop (children's) behavior by instruction and practice; especially to teach self-control
v punish in order to gain control or enforce obedience
disciplining.translation: v. 训练( discipline的现在分词 ); （通过训练和监督）使有纪律; 处罚; 使有条理

discipular.translation: a. 信徒的,门徒的, 追随者的,崇奉者的
